name: Neon Tide
tagline: A racing game where the track is a living tide.
description: A racing game where the track is a living tide. Dive down the face of each wave, launch off the crest, and chain perfect landings to build your combo while a storm closes in behind you. Race the Daily Tide against every player on the same water.
controls: Hold Space/W/Up, touch or A/RT to dive, release to launch; steer A/D, arrows, drag or left stick; Shift/B to boost
